parsed.name: 微量液体泵
parsed.description: 一种用于输送微升级液体的实验室泵，可按设定体积、流速和方向推动液体通过管路。常用于微流控、样品传输、试剂加样和流路预充等实验操作。
parsed.description_en: A laboratory pump for moving microliter-scale liquids through tubing with defined volume, flow rate, and direction. It is commonly used for microfluidics, sample transfer, reagent delivery, and priming fluid lines.

actions.description: 按设定体积、流速和方向对泵路进行预充液。
actions.description_en: Prime the pump line with the specified volume, flow rate, and direction.
